signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own the CodePath EDU product end-to-end
Talk with faculty and administrators every week, and turn what you learn into a prioritized roadmap tied to adoption, retention, and growth
Take our LMS integrations with key higher education tools like Canvas and Blackboard to maturity
Use AI across your entire workflow to compress weeks into days: prototypes, requirements, evals for the AI features you ship, and your own analysis of usage data
Partner with Higher Education Partnerships on what each campus needs to adopt, expand, and move to a deeper partnership, and give that team the product evidence they bring to…

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Learner Platform Experience

bullets: Own the core learner platform experience across every segment: college CS students, alumni, working engineers, and students at partner institutions
Translate learning, retention, and engagement goals into a prioritized roadmap
Use AI across your entire workflow to compress weeks into days, raising the quality and the speed of what you ship
Own our AI-assisted learning experiences end to end, including taking the AI Tutor and AI Grader from prototype to product. These student-facing AI surfaces are yours, not shared
Decide where AI accelerates effectiveness, productivity, and scale, and where human connection is essential to maintain motivation, commitment, and progress
